d:
Anant Singh aur Anand Mohan ki mushkilen barhti najar aa rahi hain. ek taraph mokama ke bahubli neta anant sinh se jura mamla charcha men hai, to dusri taraph purv sansad aanand mohan ko suprim kort ne ek mahine ke bhitar sarendar karne ka aadesh diya hai. samjhie dhaee sal bad kaise sach huee tejasvi yadav ki purani bhavishyavani , janie puri rajnitik kahani.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
